name: Ragic
description:
Ragic MCP gives Claude read-only access to your Ragic databases, including comments and email threads tied to any record. Once connected, Claude can analyze trends, flag what needs follow-up, and help you think through next steps using your real business data.

Ragic is a no-code AI platform for building custom database systems — CRM, inventory, project tracking, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ragic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ragic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.ragic.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ragic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ragic provides these MCP tools: full_text_search, get_records, list_apnames, list_page, list_sheets, list_users, and read_documentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ragic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ragic in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Ragic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ragic is developed by Ragic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
